# Disneyland Paris

> > Official Disneyland Paris resort website featuring two Disney theme parks, seven hotels, dining, entertainment, and trip planning resources for visitors to Europe's premier Disney destination.

Disneyland Paris offers comprehensive information about visiting the resort, including Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park. The site provides ticket purchasing, hotel packages, attraction guides, and special experiences featuring Disney, Pixar, Marvel, and Star Wars properties.

## Key Topics

- Disneyland Park
- Walt Disney Studios Park
- Disney Hotels
- Annual Pass & Disneyland Pass
- Premier Access
- Star Wars attractions
- Marvel experiences
- Disney Village
- Disney Stars on Parade
- Character encounters
- Park tickets & admission
- Hotel packages
- Dining reservations
- Shows & parades
- Disneyland Paris Mobile App

## Getting Started & Planning

- [Disneyland Paris - tickets, deals, family holidays](https://www.disneylandparis.com/en-usd): Main homepage: tickets, hotel packages & trip planning for Disney Parks
- [Disneyland Paris tickets and packages](https://www.disneylandparis.com/en-usd/offers): Tickets & packages: pricing, Premier Access, meal plans & hotel offers
- [Discover our range of Disney Park tickets!](https://tickets.disneylandparis.com/en-usd/tickets): Ticket selection: 1-4 day passes, single/both parks & Premier Access
- [Visit Paris and Disneyland Paris](https://www.disneylandparis.com/en-usd/us-visit-paris-and-disneyland-paris): Paris visitor guide: transportation, tickets & combining city with parks

## Parks & Experiences

- [Become part of a magical world!](https://www.disneylandparis.com/en-usd/disneyland-paris-experience): Park experience overview: attractions, shows, characters & dining guide
- [Disneyland Park — Attractions, Parades, Character Encounters and Disney Magic](https://www.disneylandparis.com/en-usd/destinations/disneyland-park): Disneyland Park: 5 lands, Sleeping Beauty Castle, Star Wars & attractions

## Optional

- [Disneyland Paris - tickets, deals, family holidays (Adult-focused)](https://adulte-disneyland.disneylandparis.com/): Official homepage: 2 Disney Parks, 7 Hotels, golf & Disney Village info
